text:
Maria (CSM): @alex_ae / @jon_se / @priya_onboarding — kicking off Orchid Labs onboarding. Quick summary: they want inference-in-prod for their recommendation pipeline, target latency < 80ms p95, and runway to GA in 10 weeks. Renewal is annual; first renewal review in ~11 months. :wave:
Alex (AE): noted. Are we aligned on SLA ask? They mentioned 99.5% uptime for inference endpoints and dedicated capacity after pilot.
Maria (CSM): Yes — pilot is hosted, then Dedicated if throughput > 300 requests/s. Success criteria I proposed to Orchid: (1) stable latency under 80ms p95 for 95% traffic, (2) end-to-end test harness integrated into CI, (3) shadow traffic for one week before cutover.
Jon (SE): I'll own the CI/infra checklist. Need sandbox access from them + sample production traffic profile (qps, token lengths). Can we get a dataset extract?
Priya (Onboarding): I'll run enablement sessions: Week 1 = integration + SSO test, Week 2 = model tuning + perf runbook, Week 4 = canary and rollback drills. Posting a 30/60/90 view below. :calendar:
Priya (Onboarding): 30d: API integration, SSO ok, basic evals pass. 60d: perf tuning, KV cache hits >60%, runbook validated. 90d: production cutover + handoff to Success Ops; customer dashboard configured.
Kevin (Support): I'll set up a dedicated support rotation for their account during pilot. Need notification hooks (PagerDuty team) and an access ticket when they hit >100rps.
Maria (CSM): Risk callout: customer uses PII-ish data; they asked about on-prem/private options. Need SOC2 + KMS notes for sales. Also renewal risk if we miss 90d GA. Keep that in mind. :warning:
Jon (SE): Action items for me:
- Get sample traffic + schema (Orchid to provide by Fri).
- Provision sandbox model with 2 variants (low-latency quantized + higher-accuracy fp16).
- Add tracing hooks to debug p95 spikes.
(Onboard instructions)
```
# provision sandbox token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/sandbox/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"customer":"orchid-labs"}'
```
Maria (CSM): @onboard-bot can you provision the sandbox org?
onboard-bot: Sandbox org `orchid-sbx-1987` created. Tokens posted to secure vault. :white_check_mark:
Alex (AE): I'll coordinate contract notes: add Dedicated trigger at 300rps and SOC2 appendix. Also loop in legal for KMS language.
Priya (Onboarding): Scheduling note — first enablement kickoff with their infra lead is Tue 10am PT. I'll send the calendar. Can someone own the invite and attach the onboarding playbook?
Maria (CSM): I'll send the invite and attach the playbook. Please confirm deck + runbook by EOD Monday.
Kevin (Support): I’ll create the PagerDuty integration and a short runbook snippet for triage (latency vs model quality).
Jon (SE): One more thing — can we get sample error traces from their current infra so we can map to our tracing fields? Maria, can you request that from their SRE?
Maria (CSM): Will request. I'll capture all commitments in the kickoff doc and share a 1-pager with stakeholders after the call.
Alex (AE): LGTM. Also flagging upsell motion: add a performance SLA add-on page to the renewal playbook.
Priya (Onboarding): Thanks team — I'll post the Week 1 agenda and links to test harness tomorrow.
Maria (CSM): Great. Closing actions: Jon=CI + sandbox, Priya=enablement agenda, Alex=contract appendix, Kevin=PD/rotation, Maria=customer ask + doc. Backfill if I missed anything. :+1:
Alex (AE): confirmed.
Jon (SE): confirmed.
Kevin (Support): confirmed.
Priya (Onboarding): confirmed.
Maria (CSM): Thanks — see you on Tue.
